description: Chronicle SIEM Threat Hunter specialist that runs UDM event searches, triages security alerts, inspects rules and ingestion feeds, and checks IOC matches.
name: threat_hunter_agent

skills.description: Searches Chronicle SIEM UDM events, lists recent security alerts, summarizes host/user/IP entities, and checks IOC matches.
examples: List the 5 most recent security alerts in Chronicle SIEM
Run a UDM search for recent network or process events
skills.name: Chronicle UDM threat hunting and alert triage

skills.description: Evaluates Chronicle SIEM alerts or UDM event batches in a single zero-output-token Gemini Decision 1 pass for severity (1-5), true-positive likelihood, MITRE ATT&CK tactic, and next action.
examples: Score these 5 Chronicle security alerts for severity and next action
Triage this UDM event batch and recommend dismiss, enrich_cti, escalate_tier2, or tune_yaral2
skills.name: Chronicle alert and UDM batch rubric scoring

skills.description: Attempts Chronicle SIEM feed deletion, rule creation, or reference list creation via Chronicle MCP (governed by Agent Gateway allowlist).
examples: Create a new reference list in Chronicle
skills.name: Chronicle feed administration and rule creation
